headline: Nvidia Suspends Shipping U.S.-Approved AI Chips to China
summary: Nvidia has suspended shipments of powerful artificial intelligence chips to China, its interim CEO said, raising doubts over a special licensing agreement negotiated between Washington and Beijing.
why: Export restrictions on advanced semiconductors affect major tech companies' revenues and complicate cross-border supply chains for artificial intelligence hardware.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corp
impacts.why: Halting shipments to a major market like China directly restricts potential revenue streams for advanced AI hardware.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding trade compliance and the suspension of key product deliveries to a major customer base impacted market sentiment.
